notes: Single source of truth for every configurable parameter. The API serves this at /api/v1/generation/schema; the frontend renders forms from it. 'kind' separates model generation parameters from ComfyUI workflow execution parameters and from post-processing. 'native' records whether the native YuE2 runtime has a true equivalent; unsupported parameters are disabled in the UI with the stated reason rather than silently ignored.

groups.label: Model
groups.description: Which weights and runtime back the generation.

groups.label: Planning
groups.description: Symbolic ABC plan written before any audio.

groups.label: Generation
groups.description: Acoustic token sampling, seed and duration budget.

parameters.label: Style
parameters.help: Genre, instruments, vocal character, language and tempo. Example: 'Cinematic Bengali folk-pop, warm male vocal, acoustic guitar, bamboo flute, organic drums, melancholic but hopeful, 92 BPM'.

parameters.label: Lyrics
parameters.help: The words to sing. Use section tags on their own line: [Intro], [Verse], [Pre-Chorus], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro].

options.label: Full Song
options.help: Plan melody and chords as ABC, then generate audio.

options.label: Melody Guided
options.help: Plan melody only, leaving the accompaniment freer.

options.label: Direct Audio
options.help: Generate audio with no symbolic plan.

options.label: Cover
options.help: Condition on a melody transcribed from reference audio.

options.label: Score Edit
options.help: Regenerate from an ABC score you edited.

parameters.label: ABC score
parameters.help: External composition used directly instead of a generated plan. Requires Full Song or Melody Guided; the native melody input has Vocal and Ins voices and no chord symbols.

parameters.label: Model
parameters.help: Local YuE2 model directory. Leave on the default to use the path from .env.

comfy.note: ComfyUI packages the model as a single .safetensors checkpoint; the native runtime loads a model directory.

parameters.label: Model revision
parameters.help: Pin a Hugging Face revision for comparisons. Ignored when the model is a local directory.

options.label: YuE2-Vae (listening)
options.help: Default decoder for generation and listening.

comfy.note: The workflow takes the VAE from the same checkpoint.

parameters.label: Decoder revision
parameters.help: Pin the decoder revision for comparisons.

parameters.label: Compute backend
parameters.help: Autoregressive decoding backend. vLLM needs the optional 'fast' extras.

parameters.label: Quantization
parameters.help: With 48 GB of VRAM the unquantized preset is the quality default.

comfy.note: ComfyUI selects precision by choosing a different checkpoint file, e.g. yue2_convrot_int8.safetensors.

parameters.label: Offload AR weights during synthesis
parameters.help: Moves the autoregressive weights off the GPU while latents are synthesised. Slower, but lowers the memory peak.

parameters.label: GPU memory budget (GiB)
parameters.help: Caps this process's GPU allocation and selects decoder chunking. The documented baseline is 24; an RTX A6000 has 48.

parameters.label: Offline (local files only)
parameters.help: Never contact Hugging Face during a generation.

parameters.label: Planner temperature
parameters.help: Randomness while writing the ABC plan. Lower keeps the composition conventional.

comfy.note: Not exposed as a widget in the reference workflow.

parameters.label: Planner top-p
parameters.help: Nucleus sampling cutoff for the plan.

parameters.label: Planner top-k
parameters.help: Number of candidate tokens considered for the plan.

parameters.label: Planner repetition penalty
parameters.help: Discourages repeated bars. Scores repeat by design, so the default is nearly neutral.

parameters.label: Planner penalty window
parameters.help: How many recent tokens the repetition penalty looks at.

parameters.label: Planner minimum tokens
parameters.help: Stops the plan from ending immediately.

parameters.label: ABC max tokens
parameters.help: Ceiling on plan length. Hitting it marks the result truncated rather than failing.

parameters.label: Planner seed
parameters.help: Separate seed for the planning stage.

native.note: The native pipeline derives both the plan and the acoustic tokens from one request seed (yue2.protocol.SongRequest.seed). Use Generation seed instead.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.help: The same seed with the same settings and the same weights reproduces a generation.

parameters.label: Seed behaviour

options.label: Randomize
options.help: Draw a new seed on the server for each run and record it.

options.label: Increment
options.help: Add one to the seed after each run.

parameters.help: Applied by the studio before the request reaches the model. The seed actually used is always saved to the manifest.

native.note: Resolved by the studio; the runtime only ever sees a concrete seed.

parameters.label: Temperature
parameters.help: Randomness of the acoustic tokens. Higher is more adventurous and less stable.

parameters.label: Top-p
parameters.help: Keeps only the most likely tokens that together reach this probability.

parameters.label: Top-k
parameters.help: Hard cap on how many candidate tokens are considered at each step.

parameters.label: Repetition penalty
parameters.help: Pushes the model away from looping the same material.

parameters.label: Penalty window
parameters.help: How many recent acoustic tokens the repetition penalty considers.

parameters.label: Minimum tokens
parameters.help: Floor on song length: 25 tokens is one second of audio, so 200 is eight seconds.

parameters.label: Maximum duration
parameters.help: Upper bound on song length. The model stops when the song is finished, so a longer limit does not force a longer song. One second is 25 acoustic tokens.

native.note: Converted to tokens with the VAE's 25 frames per second (sample_rate 48000 / downsampling_ratio 1920).

parameters.label: Semantic max tokens (override)
parameters.help: Set the token ceiling directly instead of deriving it from the duration. Leave empty to use Maximum duration.

parameters.label: Guidance (CFG)
parameters.help: How strongly the text and score steer the audio. Empty uses the runtime default: 1.0 with a plan, 1.01 without one.

parameters.label: Synthesis steps
parameters.help: Solver steps used to turn acoustic tokens into latents. More steps cost time; the default is the validated setting.

parameters.label: Solver
parameters.help: Fixed by the runtime protocol at this context length.

comfy.note: ComfyUI's sampler list is a different mechanism and does not map onto this.

parameters.label: Sampler
parameters.help: ComfyUI KSampler sampler.

native.note: The native runtime solves the flow-matching ODE with a fixed midpoint solver and has no sampler list. Use Synthesis steps instead.

parameters.label: Scheduler
parameters.help: ComfyUI KSampler noise schedule.

native.note: No native equivalent: the solver uses a uniform midpoint schedule.

parameters.label: Denoise
parameters.help: ComfyUI partial-denoise strength.

native.note: The native pipeline always solves the full trajectory; there is no partial-denoise entry point.

parameters.label: Latent length (seconds)
parameters.help: ComfyUI allocates an empty latent of this length before sampling.

native.note: The native pipeline sizes latents from the acoustic tokens the model actually emitted, so there is nothing to preallocate. Use Maximum duration.

parameters.label: Batch size
parameters.help: ComfyUI latent batch size.

native.note: One pipeline call produces one candidate. Queue several generations to get variations.

parameters.label: Decoder mode

options.label: Tiled
options.help: Decodes in chunks. Predictable memory, works at any length.

options.label: Whole song
options.help: Decodes in one pass. Faster when VRAM allows; can run out of memory on long songs.

parameters.help: The reference workflow notes that regular decoding is faster when there is enough VRAM. It is not guaranteed to fit at every duration.

comfy.note: ComfyUI models this as two separate nodes, VAEDecodeAudio and VAEDecodeAudioTiled.

parameters.label: Tile size (latent frames)
parameters.help: Latent frames decoded per chunk; 25 frames is one second. Smaller tiles use less memory and take longer.

comfy.note: The workflow's 1920 is the VAE downsampling ratio, not this frame count.

parameters.label: Tile overlap (latent frames)
parameters.help: Context decoded either side of each tile and then cropped. Fixed by the runtime.

parameters.label: Format

options.label: FLAC (24-bit)
options.help: The runtime's own lossless output. No re-encoding.

options.label: MP3
options.help: Converted from the canonical FLAC with FFmpeg after generation.

parameters.help: FLAC and WAV are written by the model runtime. MP3 is an explicit post-processing conversion and keeps the lossless file alongside it.

parameters.label: Filename prefix
parameters.help: Prefix for downloaded files. Artifact paths on disk are derived from ids and do not change.

native.note: Applied by the studio when a file is downloaded.

parameters.label: Keep the lossless master
parameters.help: The model's own output is always retained untouched as the canonical artifact.
